title: Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
Translate stakeholderinputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;
Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
+8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
+3 years of experiencesupporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
Excellent written andverbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
Experiencewith enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
Fluent in English;

title: Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Servicenow Application Portfolio Management (Apm) & Data Quality Engineer - Contractor In Usd em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. For our international customer in Valencia, we are looking for a ServiceNow Application Portfolio Management (APM) & Data Quality Engineer. The role focuses on ongoing APM data maintenance in ServiceNow (APM/CMDB-related records as applicable), identifying data gaps and inconsistencies, coordinating updates with application/service owners, and tracking technical debt indicators and remediation progress. EU candidates are welcome to apply. Candidates need to be based in Valencia or willing to relocate to Valencia. Candidates need to be flexible to work across time zones, including alignment with US Eastern Time where required. Work permit is not provided. Candidates need to be fluent in English. Tasks and responsibilities: Perform ongoing maintenance of Application Portfolio Management (APM) data within ServiceNow, including application inventory, ownership, lifecycle status, technology attributes, and documented integrations/dependencies, ensuring data accuracy, completeness, and currency;
Identify and remediate data quality issues such as missing or invalid values, duplicate records, and inconsistent classifications through coordination with application owners, service owners, and relevant stakeholders;
Maintain and enhance portfolio data governance standards and controlled vocabularies, including lifecycle states, business and technical fit assessments, and application criticality classifications;
Monitor and track technical debt indicators leveraging ServiceNow portfolio data, including lifecycle and obsolescence risks, unsupported technologies, architectural non-conformities, and resilience or operability gaps;
Maintain a centralized log or aligned ServiceNow records documenting technical debt items, including impacted applications/services, severity and priority ratings, and recommended remediation actions such as retirement, replacement, or modernization;
Develop and deliver recurring dashboards, reports, and portfolio insights for the onsite Enterprise Architect, including technical debt trends, aging remediation items, progress tracking, and portfolio risk hotspots;
Translate stakeholderinputs, priorities, and publishing schedules into updates for the APM website and related communication materials;
Maintain and support the APM website as a central platform for publishing portfolio data, standards, insights, lifecycle guidance, and reference information related to Application Portfolio Management practices;
Profile: Master's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline;
+8 years of overall experience in Information Technology;
+3 years of experiencesupporting Enterprise Architects or working within Enterprise Architecture teams;
Hands-on experience with ServiceNow, specifically supporting Application Portfolio Management (APM) data, including application and CMDB records, data validation, monitoring, maintenance, and reporting;
Strong understanding of Application Portfolio Management (APM) principles, including application inventory management, lifecycle governance, business and technical fit assessments, risk and obsolescence analysis, and application rationalization strategies (retire, replace, modernize);
Proven experience identifying, documenting, and tracking technical debt, including the definition of debt indicators, maintenance of remediation records, and generation of actionable reporting and insights;
Solid understanding of Enterprise Architecture concepts and practices, including architecture principles, standards, governance, target-state architecture, roadmaps, and architecture deliverables, as well as the role of portfolio data in strategic decision-making;
Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with distributed stakeholders to resolve data quality issues and drive timely completion of application and portfolio record updates;
Previous experience delivering similar ServiceNow APM and technical debt management activities within large or complex enterprise environments is highly preferred;
Strong analytical, reporting, and problem-solving capabilities, including experience producing dashboards, scorecards, KPI reporting, and trend analysis with a strong focus on data integrity and attention to detail;
AI literacy, including practical experience using AI and Generative AI tools to enhance productivity in areas such as data analysis, reporting, documentation, and knowledge management, within approved enterprise governance frameworks;
Excellent written andverbal communication skills, with the ability to document processes, prepare executive-ready materials, and communicate findings effectively to Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders;
Working knowledge of Enterprise Architecture frameworks and methodologies such as TOGAF and their practical application in enterprise architecture deliverables and governance processes;
Working knowledge of ServiceNow data model fundamentals relevant to Application Portfolio Management, including CMDB structures, application records, CSDM concepts, and portfolio data governance practices;
Relevant certifications are considered an advantage, including: TOGAF or equivalent Enterprise Architecture certification;
ServiceNow Certified System Administrator (CSA);
ServiceNow Certified Application Developer (CAD) and/or relevant ServiceNow implementation certifications related to APM or CMDB;
Experiencewith enterprise architecture and portfolio management tooling, including ServiceNow EA Workspace and APM reporting capabilities, is considered a plus;
Familiarity with responsible AI principles and the secure use of enterprise AI assistants, including prompt hygiene and protection of sensitive information, is considered an advantage;
Fluent in English;

Confira esta oportunidade para Banco De Talentos Pcd | Lojas Adidas Salvador em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Objetivo e Relevância Global para a Organização:


Contribuir para o alcance das metas de KPI da loja, proporcionando uma experiência memorável para os consumidores e praticando os Valores da Marca, garantindo um ambiente inclusivo, colaborativo e acolhedor para todos os talentos.


Responsabilidades e atribuições

Principais Responsabilidades:


- Atuar no atendimento ao consumidor, oferecendo suporte e garantindo uma experiência de compra positiva e alinhada aos padrões de excelência da adidas.

- Apoiar as operações da loja de acordo com as necessidades do negócio, podendo atuar em diferentes frentes como atendimento, organização de produtos, estoque, caixa e suporte operacional.

- Contribuir para o alcance das metas individuais e coletivas da loja por meio de um atendimento de qualidade e foco na experiência do consumidor.

- Colaborar com a equipe em atividades operacionais e rotinas diárias da loja, garantindo organização, agilidade e eficiência nos processos.

- Cumprir todas as políticas e procedimentos da loja, contribuindo para um ambiente de trabalho seguro, respeitoso e inclusivo.

- Utilizar as ferramentas digitais e soluções omnichannel disponíveis para apoiar a jornada de compra do consumidor.

- Participar ativamente dos treinamentos e ações de desenvolvimento disponibilizados pela adidas.

- Demonstrar os 3 Cs da adidas (Confiança, Colaboração e Criatividade), fortalecendo a cultura da marca no dia a dia.

- Trabalhar em equipe, respeitando as individualidades e contribuindo para um ambiente acolhedor, diverso e inclusivo para todos.


Requisitos e qualificações

Habilidades e Conhecimentos:


- Boa comunicação e facilidade para trabalhar em equipe.

- Interesse em atuar com atendimento ao consumidor e rotinas de loja.

- Organização, responsabilidade e proatividade.

- Vontade de aprender e se desenvolver no ambiente de retail.

- Capacidade de adaptação às diferentes atividades e necessidades da operação.

- Afinidade com esporte, moda e cultura da marca será considerado um diferencial.


Experiência e Formação Exigidas / Qualificações Mínimas:


- Ensino médio completo ou cursando.

- Não é necessária experiência prévia, mas experiência com atendimento ao consumidor será considerada um diferencial.

- Vaga destinada a pessoas com deficiência (PCD).

title: Auxiliar De Loja - Afirmativa Para Pessoas Com Deficiência | Barra Shopping / Ba
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Auxiliar De Loja - Afirmativa Para Pessoas Com Deficiência | Barra Shopping / Ba em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

NOSSAS PESSOAS, JUNTAS, LIDERAM COM CONSCIÊNCIA.


Na Natura, temos potencial para impulsionar transformações significativas. Isso é possível por meio dos produtos inovadores da Natura e Avon;
das experiências marcantes dos serviços de beleza da Bluma e da nossa plataforma de educação financeira, a Emana Pay. Marcas e serviços relevantes para quem os utiliza e reconhecidos pelo nosso compromisso com a condução de negócios regenerativos.


Endereço: Av. Centenário, 2992 - Chame-Chame, Salvador - BA,


Estamos em busca de um(a) Auxiliar de Loja para atuar na nossa Casa da Consultora. Aqui, nosso papel vai muito além de vender: nós acolhemos, apoiamos e impulsionamos o negócio de milhares de consultoras Natura e Avon.


Seu principal desafio será garantir que essas consultoras tenham a melhor experiência ao retirar seus produtos e planejar suas vendas!


Principais Responsabilidades:


  • Profissional que será o responsável pela organização do estoque da loja;
  • Fazer a separação de produtos a fim de atender os pedidos captados, de forma rápida e com qualidade (sem falta, danos e/ou excessos);
  • Obedecer todos os regulamentos e procedimentos de trabalho da empresa;
  • Garantir a organização dos produtos nas prateleiras;
  • Limpeza das prateleiras;
  • Apoio na separação e armazenamento dos produtos no estoque;
  • Montagem das caixas/embalagens para a confecção de kits diversos;
  • Apoio na precificação dos produtos;


Quais os requisitos?


  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Experiência em atendimento ao público;
  • Experiência no segmento de beleza (será um diferencial).


O que você vai encontrar por aqui?


Somos mais do que um lugar de trabalho: construímos e vivemos diariamente o Ecossistema Bem Estar Bem, baseado na relação harmoniosa entre cada indivíduo, as relações ao seu redor e o ambiente em que está inserido. Além de oferecer benefícios voltados ao bem-estar social, físico, financeiro, mental e emocional, promovemos um ambiente de prosperidade, pertencimento e propósito, fortalecendo uma rede sólida de apoio, expansão de consciência e respeito à diversidade, equidade e inclusão.


Somos um movimento que transforma a maneira de viver e fazer negócios em 14 países da América Latina, sempre guiados por consciência.


Conhece alguma pessoa aqui na Natura?


Se sim, peça o e-mail corporativo dessa pessoa e, ao se inscrever para uma vaga, utilize-o para solicitar uma recomendação. É uma excelente oportunidade para fortalecer sua rede de contatos e avançar no seu processo seletivo em nossa empresa!


A Natura celebra e abraça a diversidade em todas as suas formas e pluralidades.


Convidamos #Mulheres, #PessoasNegras, #PessoasComDeficiência, pessoas da comunidade #LGBTQIA+, #Gestantes e pessoas com #50anos+ a se candidatarem para esta vaga!

title: Advovado(A) Trainee
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Advovado(A) Trainee em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

A empresa contratante é um escritório de advocacia, reconhecido pela excelência em consultoria jurídica e pela inovação em soluções legais. Ela está em busca de um Advogado Trainee - Empresarial para integrar seu time, contribuindo para o crescimento sustentável de seus clientes.


Responsabilidades

  • Atuar nas atividades contenciosas e/ou consultivas, conforme a área de atuação designada;
  • Apoiar a gestãode processos e demandas jurídicas por meio dos sistemas internos do escritório;
  • Realizar a conferência, organização e controle de documentos jurídicos e administrativos;
  • Solicitar, coletar e organizar informações e documentos necessários à condução dos processos e projetos jurídicos;
  • Prestar suporteno relacionamento institucional com órgãos públicos e entidades externas;
  • Monitorar publicações processuais, identificando prazos e propondo providências pertinentes;
  • Elaborar pesquisas, pareceres jurídicos, relatórios, materiais técnicos e apresentações, sob orientação da coordenação jurídica;
  • Redigir peças processuais e manifestações jurídicas, sob supervisão;
  • Participar de reuniões internas e de atendimento a clientes, contribuindo para o desenvolvimento das demandas;
  • Acompanhar audiências presenciais e virtuais, prestando suporte às atividades processuais;
  • Auxiliar no acompanhamento e controle dos procedimentos patrocinados pelo escritório;
  • Elaborar contratos comerciais, instrumentos societários e demais documentos jurídicos correlatos;
  • Apoiar a formalização, registro e atualização de atos societários junto aos órgãos competentes;
  • Realizar o apontamento diário de atividades e horas trabalhadas no sistema de controle (timesheet).


Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Graduação em Direito, com ênfase em Direito Empresarial ou áreas afins.
  • Estágio em Direito preferencialmente em escritórios corporativos.
  • Domínio da legislação brasileira , especialmente Código Civil, Lei das Sociedades Anônimas e Lei de Registros Públicos.
  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal em português.


Benefícios

✔ Ajuda de Custo

✔ Estacionamento



Associado | Salário compatível com o mercado

⏰ Seg. a Sex. | Horário Comercial

title: Desenhista Industrial
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Desenhista Industrial em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

O que irá fazer:

  • Desenvolver, revisar e manter layouts industriais e arranjos físicos da fábrica;
  • Elaborar desenhos técnicos 2D em AutoCAD para áreas produtivas, instalações e fluxos industriais;
  • Criar e atualizar modelos 3D utilizando Inventor, SketchUp e ferramentas correlatas;
  • Realizar estudos de viabilidade e simulações de layout;
  • Representar máquinas, equipamentos, linhas de produção, estoques, circulação de pessoas e fluxo de materiais;
  • Apoiar projetosde implantação, ampliação e reorganização fabril;
  • Realizar levantamentos técnicos e medições em campo;
  • Atualizar documentação técnica e revisões de projetos;
  • Propor melhorias com foco em produtividade, ergonomia, segurança e otimização de espaço;
  • Atuar em conjunto com diversas áreas da fábrica, como engenharia de processos, engenharia de produto, logística e áreas operacionais;
  • Realizar follow-up e validações técnicas junto às áreas envolvidas nos projetos.


O que precisa ter:

  • Curso técnico completo em Mecânica, Eletromecânica, Edificações ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 3 anos em ambiente industrial;
  • Vivência com desenvolvimento de layouts fabris e desenhos industriais;
  • Experiência em segmentos como Construção Civil, Indústria Naval ou Indústria Automobilística;
  • Conhecimentos obrigatórios: AutoCAD 2D (nível intermediário/avançado), SketchUp, leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos, conhecimento em layout industrial e fluxo fabril, e conhecimento arquitetônico aplicado ao ambiente industrial;
  • Conhecimentos desejáveis: Inventor (3D), UBIM, NR-12, ergonomia, segurança industrial, Lean Manufacturing, 5S e arranjo físico industrial.


Benefícios

  • Refeitório no local
  • Transporte Fretado
  • Seguro de Vida Hire Now Company®
  • Auxílio Atividade Física Hire Now Company®
  • Saúde Digital Integrada Hire Now Company®
  • Auxílio Acadêmico Hire Now Company®

title: Graphic Designer
description:

Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você. title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

title: Technical Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you someone who understands a technology solution inside and out — and knows how to turn that knowledge into real value for clients? We're looking for someone who doesn't fit the traditional mold of Account Manager or Technical Support. We need both at once: a technical consultant who speaks the client's language, understands their operations, and knows exactly how our platform can grow their business. This role is not primarily focused on acquiring new clients. Your mission will be to deepen, expand, and maximize the value our current clients get from the platform — through upselling, cross-selling, and long-term consultative relationships. ABOUT THE COMPANY A SaaS company in regional expansion, delivering high-impact solutions for enterprise clients across LATAM. The platform supports complex operational processes and integrates with clients' existing systems to generate measurable business value. Agile team, high-performance culture, and a product that keeps evolving. This role is central to that growth. YOUR MISSION You will be the strategic link between the company and its most important clients. Your job is to make sure each client not only uses the platform well, but continuously discovers new ways it can transform their business. From day one, you'll operate as a trusted technical consultant: someone who understands the solution's architecture, knows the integration possibilities, and can articulate expansion opportunities in the client's language. WHAT YOU'LL DO Account Growth – Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities within the existing client base. – Build account growth plans: understand each client's roadmap and align it with our product evolution. – Manage renewal and expansion cycles with a long-term focus. Applied Technical Consulting – Develop a deep understanding of how our platform works: architecture, modules, APIs, and integrations. – Analyze client systems (ERP, BMS, CMMS, CRM, and others) to identify integration and expansion opportunities. – Participate in technical meetings, discovery sessions, and consultative presentations alongside product and engineering teams. Strategic Client Relationships – Maintain high-level relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders within each account. – Be the client's go-to consultative reference: the person they call when they want to evolve, not just when they have a problem. – Monitor account health (adoption, usage, ROI) and act proactively on risk or opportunity signals. Internal Collaboration – Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Support teams to ensure a cohesive client experience. – Translate client needs into the product roadmap in a structured, evidence-based way. – Maintain pipeline, forecast, and expansion metrics in CRM with rigor and consistency. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Experience – 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Technical Consulting roles at SaaS or technology companies. – Proven track record managing enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal cycles. – Demonstrable history of upselling and cross-selling driven by technical knowledge and consultative relationships. – Experience in LATAM markets is highly valued. Technical Profile (core requirement)– Background in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or related fields — or a commercial profile with a solid, demonstrable technical foundation. – Genuine ability to understand how software works: modules, integrations, APIs, and data flows. – Experience engaging with client system architectures and evaluating integration scenarios. – Comfortable moving between technical conversations (IT, Engineering) and executive ones (C-Level, Operations). Language Requirements – Spanish fluency is mandatory — all current clients operate in Spanish across LATAM. – English proficiency is required for this role. – Portuguese is a plus. Nice to Have – Experience with SaaS solutions, IoT, smart buildings, analytics, digital platforms, or operational transformation. – Industry knowledge in retail, airports, hospitality, real estate, or large physical operations. – Familiarity with CRM tools and Customer Success methodologies (Gainsight, ChurnZero, HubSpot, or similar). WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO... – Sells from expertise, not from a catalog. – Sees client success as their own performance metric. – Is curious, analytical, and energized by complex problems. – Can build both technical and commercial trust simultaneously. – Thrives in dynamic environments with real autonomy and high standards. WHAT THIS OPPORTUNITY OFFERS – A strategic role with direct impact on company growth. – Work with an innovative SaaS platform in active regional expansion. – Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams. – Agile, collaborative culture focused on high performance. – Real space for professional growth and career development across LATAM. Interested? If your career has combined technical knowledge with commercial impact — if you understand how software works from the inside and know how to translate that into client value — we'd love to meet you. Apply and tell us: how have you helped a client grow by getting more out of the technology they already had?

Excelente comunicação verbal e escrita, com clareza, objetividade e capacidade de gerar interesse genuíno no primeiro contato. Compreensão de métricas de funil SaaS: MQL, SAL, SQL, taxa de conversão por etapa e ciclo médio de vendas. Acesso a tecnologia de ponta no processo comercial, incluindo IA integrada ao fluxo de trabalho. Possibilidade de contrato stock options;

title: Senior Devops / Infrastructure Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Senior Devops / Infrastructure Engineer em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Senior DevOps / Infrastructure Engineer Location: Brazil (Remote) Role Overview: Sphise is looking for an experienced DevOps Engineer with extensive AWS and IaaC experience. This is the first role in our new DevOps group, and this person will be responsible for transitioning all of the current processes from Development to DevOps. The ideal candidate will have strong knowledge of supporting production PHP/JS/MySQL environments, ideally environments that utilize Laravel. You will establish, maintain, and execute organizational policies and procedures for change management, configuration management, release and deployment management, service monitoring, support, and problem management. Responsibilities: Set up and manage the CI/CD pipeline and ensure software builds, packages, and deploys to production during non-business US hours. Create and deploy a true IaaC environment for all DevOps and infrastructure operations using Terraform, Ansible, or other similar tools. Collaborate with Development management to determine the best cloud architecture to support the application. Gather, challenge, clarify, and document technical requirements coming from the development team. Participate in the production readiness meetings for all software releases. Develop processes to automate DevOps functions, source code checking with continuous integration, automated test tool configuration, application topology configuration, automated deployment, and proactive environment monitoring & management. Must exhibit a high-level end-to-end understanding of web application design, construction, testing, deployment, and delivery. Create and implement the DevOps roadmap and measure success via key performance indicators agreed with management. Gather product & business requirements, gut check new ideas and proposals, balance tech-debt and delivery of product functionality. Ensure the production SaaS environment is managed, supported, and controlled with the appropriate level of governance and agility. Establish and maintain test environments in AWS. Skills and Qualifications: Bachelors degree in computer science or related field or equivalent work experience. Strong knowledge of PHP and PHP-based web frameworks, ideally Laravel. Extensive experience with AWS, particularly EC2 (Load Balancer, Ubuntu VMs), RDS (MySQL 5.7), Elasticache (Redis), Route 53, Terraform, Ansible, etc. Experience with Google Cloud is a big plus. Demonstrated ability to lead and execute with efficiency. Thrives in a fast-paced environment and acts as a partner with the development team with the shared goal of moving the business forward. You observe, analyze, and optimize all processes. You can provide clear verbal and written communication across various cross-functional teams. Benefits Competitive salary to recognize and reward your achievements. Flexible work environment. Opportunities for professional and personal growth. Join us on this journey, and together, we'll create a future of excellence and innovation. Send in your application with your CV to (or Apply via LinkedIn).

description:

Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

Overview of the role The Process Documentation Expert position focuses on serving as the knowledge extraction and translation expert for the organization. This role involves conducting discovery sessions with busy stakeholders, asking the right questions to capture complete process information in single sessions, and transforming that knowledge into documentation so clear that new employees can follow it perfectly on their first try while owning the entire documentation lifecycle from discovery to delivery. title: Product Owner
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Product Owner em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description Metrobi is a delivery fulfillment platform designed specifically to support local businesses. We help these businesses manage their deliveries efficiently by connecting them with skilled drivers tailored to meet their delivery needs. Additionally, we provide essential tools for logistical, financial, and marketing support, empowering local food and beverage makers to expand their businesses Role of the QA Team: Our QA team is crucial in ensuring the quality of our platform. There are two main tasks you will focus on: Bug Analysis: Understand and diagnose bugs that make it into production. This requires a solid understanding of our product and excellent problem-solving skills. Proactively finding issues that affect users: Identify parts of the system that need to be improved according to feedback coming from users and testing. You need to be able to clearly report the problem and propose a solution. Feature Verification: Manually check whether new features work as intended. We're looking for candidates with strong English, product usage analysis skills, and excellent communication. This is a full-time, Monday-to-Friday position, with working hours from 8:30 AM to 5:30 PM (Boston time), including a one-hour lunch break.

title: Quality Assurance Rater - Remote Work
description:

Join our elite team of Senior Raters as a critical contributor to high-quality validation data that directly influences product development and quality assurance for leading search engines and AI technologies. This flexible, remote opportunity allows you to apply your analytical and research skills to evaluate search results and AI-generated content while contributing to the development of high-quality AI systems. A Day in the Life of a Quality Assurance Rater In this role, you'll conduct analytical assessments of search results and AI responses, providing ratings and feedback that help improve AI model performance and search quality. Your work will maintain high quality standards and deliver the accuracy our clients depend on. You'll evaluate a variety of rating tasks, analyze content with attention to detail, conduct research to support rating decisions, and identify guideline gaps or task inconsistencies. You'll also participate in training and calibration sessions while contributing feedback to improve rating processes and guidelines. Key Responsibilities Evaluate search results and AI-generated content for quality, relevance, accuracy, and usefulness. Conduct online research to verify information and support rating decisions. Apply rating guidelines consistently while maintaining quality standards. Document edge cases, guideline gaps, and task-related issues. Provide clear written feedback and rationale for ratings when required. Participate in training, calibration sessions, and ongoing quality reviews. Meet productivity expectations while maintaining high-quality work. The hourly earnings for this role are 8 USD per hour, payment is based on completed tasks. TELUS Digital AI Community Our global AI Community is a vibrant network of 1 million+ contributors from diverse backgrounds who help our customers collect, enhance, train, translate, and localize content to build better AI models. Become part of our growing community and make an impact supporting the machine learning models of some of the world's largest brands. Qualification path Candidates will complete project-specific training and qualification assessments before joining the program. Ongoing work will be subject to regular quality assurance reviews and performance monitoring. Basic Requirements Working as a freelancer with excellent communication skills in Portuguese & English. Resident in Brazil for the last 5 consecutive years. Familiarity with current and historical business, media, sports, news, social media, and cultural affairs. Strong analytical thinking, attention to detail, and research skills. Experience using web browsers, search engines, and online research tools. Daily access to a reliable broadband internet connection, smartphone, and personal computer. Demonstrated research capability through professional background OR strong track record of self-directed research and information verification Ability to work independently and follow detailed guidelines consistently. High level of creativity and logical skills with the ability to achieve consistent targets Preferred Qualifications Experience in quality assurance, content moderation, data annotation, research, journalism, editing, or information verification. Familiarity with AI technologies, search engines, and digital content ecosystems. Subject matter expertise in areas such as Popular Culture, Social Sciences, STEM, Medicine, Law, Finance, or Engineering. Additional language skills may be beneficial depending on project requirements. Equal Opportunity All qualified applicants will receive consideration for a contractual relationship without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or protected veteran status. At TELUS Digital AI, we are proud to offer equal opportunities and are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive community. All aspects of selection are based on applicants' qualifications, merits, competence, and performance without regard to any characteristic related to diversity.

title: Technical Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Customer Success Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you someone who understands a technology solution inside and out — and knows how to turn that knowledge into real value for clients? We're looking for someone who doesn't fit the traditional mold of Account Manager or Technical Support. We need both at once: a technical consultant who speaks the client's language, understands their operations, and knows exactly how our platform can grow their business. This role is not primarily focused on acquiring new clients. Your mission will be to deepen, expand, and maximize the value our current clients get from the platform — through upselling, cross-selling, and long-term consultative relationships. ABOUT THE COMPANY A SaaS company in regional expansion, delivering high-impact solutions for enterprise clients across LATAM. The platform supports complex operational processes and integrates with clients' existing systems to generate measurable business value. Agile team, high-performance culture, and a product that keeps evolving. This role is central to that growth. YOUR MISSION You will be the strategic link between the company and its most important clients. Your job is to make sure each client not only uses the platform well, but continuously discovers new ways it can transform their business. From day one, you'll operate as a trusted technical consultant: someone who understands the solution's architecture, knows the integration possibilities, and can articulate expansion opportunities in the client's language. WHAT YOU'LL DO Account Growth – Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities within the existing client base. – Build account growth plans: understand each client's roadmap and align it with our product evolution. – Manage renewal and expansion cycles with a long-term focus. Applied Technical Consulting – Develop a deep understanding of how our platform works: architecture, modules, APIs, and integrations. – Analyze client systems (ERP, BMS, CMMS, CRM, and others) to identify integration and expansion opportunities. – Participate in technical meetings, discovery sessions, and consultative presentations alongside product and engineering teams. Strategic Client Relationships – Maintain high-level relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders within each account. – Be the client's go-to consultative reference: the person they call when they want to evolve, not just when they have a problem. – Monitor account health (adoption, usage, ROI) and act proactively on risk or opportunity signals. Internal Collaboration – Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Support teams to ensure a cohesive client experience. – Translate client needs into the product roadmap in a structured, evidence-based way. – Maintain pipeline, forecast, and expansion metrics in CRM with rigor and consistency. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Experience – 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Technical Consulting roles at SaaS or technology companies. – Proven track record managing enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal cycles. – Demonstrable history of upselling and cross-selling driven by technical knowledge and consultative relationships. – Experience in LATAM markets is highly valued. Technical Profile (core requirement)– Background in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or related fields — or a commercial profile with a solid, demonstrable technical foundation. – Genuine ability to understand how software works: modules, integrations, APIs, and data flows. – Experience engaging with client system architectures and evaluating integration scenarios. – Comfortable moving between technical conversations (IT, Engineering) and executive ones (C-Level, Operations). Language Requirements – Spanish fluency is mandatory — all current clients operate in Spanish across LATAM. – English proficiency is required for this role. – Portuguese is a plus. Nice to Have – Experience with SaaS solutions, IoT, smart buildings, analytics, digital platforms, or operational transformation. – Industry knowledge in retail, airports, hospitality, real estate, or large physical operations. – Familiarity with CRM tools and Customer Success methodologies (Gainsight, ChurnZero, HubSpot, or similar). WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO... – Sells from expertise, not from a catalog. – Sees client success as their own performance metric. – Is curious, analytical, and energized by complex problems. – Can build both technical and commercial trust simultaneously. – Thrives in dynamic environments with real autonomy and high standards. WHAT THIS OPPORTUNITY OFFERS – A strategic role with direct impact on company growth. – Work with an innovative SaaS platform in active regional expansion. – Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams. – Agile, collaborative culture focused on high performance. – Real space for professional growth and career development across LATAM. Interested? If your career has combined technical knowledge with commercial impact — if you understand how software works from the inside and know how to translate that into client value — we'd love to meet you. Apply and tell us: how have you helped a client grow by getting more out of the technology they already had?

Interesse em aprender sobre gestão de produto técnico, arquitetura e ecossistemas de engenharia. When you can't, write a clear, well-documented Jira ticket and escalate to Engineering with everything they need to act quickly, and track the ticket's progress until it's complete. title: Technical Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Technical Customer Success Manager em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Are you someone who understands a technology solution inside and out — and knows how to turn that knowledge into real value for clients? We're looking for someone who doesn't fit the traditional mold of Account Manager or Technical Support. We need both at once: a technical consultant who speaks the client's language, understands their operations, and knows exactly how our platform can grow their business. This role is not primarily focused on acquiring new clients. Your mission will be to deepen, expand, and maximize the value our current clients get from the platform — through upselling, cross-selling, and long-term consultative relationships. ABOUT THE COMPANY A SaaS company in regional expansion, delivering high-impact solutions for enterprise clients across LATAM. The platform supports complex operational processes and integrates with clients' existing systems to generate measurable business value. Agile team, high-performance culture, and a product that keeps evolving. This role is central to that growth. YOUR MISSION You will be the strategic link between the company and its most important clients. Your job is to make sure each client not only uses the platform well, but continuously discovers new ways it can transform their business. From day one, you'll operate as a trusted technical consultant: someone who understands the solution's architecture, knows the integration possibilities, and can articulate expansion opportunities in the client's language. WHAT YOU'LL DO Account Growth – Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities within the existing client base. – Build account growth plans: understand each client's roadmap and align it with our product evolution. – Manage renewal and expansion cycles with a long-term focus. Applied Technical Consulting – Develop a deep understanding of how our platform works: architecture, modules, APIs, and integrations. – Analyze client systems (ERP, BMS, CMMS, CRM, and others) to identify integration and expansion opportunities. – Participate in technical meetings, discovery sessions, and consultative presentations alongside product and engineering teams. Strategic Client Relationships – Maintain high-level relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders within each account. – Be the client's go-to consultative reference: the person they call when they want to evolve, not just when they have a problem. – Monitor account health (adoption, usage, ROI) and act proactively on risk or opportunity signals. Internal Collaboration – Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Support teams to ensure a cohesive client experience. – Translate client needs into the product roadmap in a structured, evidence-based way. – Maintain pipeline, forecast, and expansion metrics in CRM with rigor and consistency. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Experience – 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Technical Consulting roles at SaaS or technology companies. – Proven track record managing enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal cycles. – Demonstrable history of upselling and cross-selling driven by technical knowledge and consultative relationships. – Experience in LATAM markets is highly valued. Technical Profile (core requirement) – Background in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or related fields — or a commercial profile with a solid, demonstrable technical foundation. – Genuine ability to understand how software works: modules, integrations, APIs, and data flows. – Experience engaging with client system architectures and evaluating integration scenarios. – Comfortable moving between technical conversations (IT, Engineering) and executive ones (C-Level, Operations). Language Requirements – Spanish fluency is mandatory — all current clients operate in Spanish across LATAM. – English proficiency is required for this role. – Portuguese is a plus. Nice to Have – Experience with SaaS solutions, IoT, smart buildings, analytics, digital platforms, or operational transformation. – Industry knowledge in retail, airports, hospitality, real estate, or large physical operations. – Familiarity with CRM tools and Customer Success methodologies (Gainsight, ChurnZero, HubSpot, or similar). WE'RE LOOKING FOR SOMEONE WHO... – Sells from expertise, not from a catalog. – Sees client success as their own performance metric. – Is curious, analytical, and energized by complex problems. – Can build both technical and commercial trust simultaneously. – Thrives in dynamic environments with real autonomy and high standards. WHAT THIS OPPORTUNITY OFFERS – A strategic role with direct impact on company growth. – Work with an innovative SaaS platform in active regional expansion. – Direct collaboration with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams. – Agile, collaborative culture focused on high performance. – Real space for professional growth and career development across LATAM. Interested? If your career has combined technical knowledge with commercial impact — if you understand how software works from the inside and know how to translate that into client value — we'd love to meet you. Apply and tell us: how have you helped a client grow by getting more out of the technology they already had?

We are part of a leading European multinational specializing in engineering and technology consulting, working with top-tier companies across the market. In Spain, we have over 5,240 professionals, 9 offices, and generate more than €217 million in revenue. At ALTEN, we are committed to diversity and equal opportunities, regardless of gender, age, abilities, or background. We believe in talent—and in the people who make it happen. If you're ready to take the next step in your career in Spain, we'd love to hear from you!

title: People Specialist - Payroll
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para People Specialist - Payroll em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Revolut People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day. As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to WorkTM. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution. About the role Revolut's People team shapes how we support our people and ensure a seamless experience every day. From onboarding to coaching and development, they partner with teams across the business to create a people-first environment that enables growth and success. We're looking for a Payroll Specialist to provide the greatest support to our employees by delivering everyday payroll tasks globally and keeping the employment life cycle running smoothly. You'll manage salaries, answer employee queries, and collaborate with third-party vendors, as well as contribute to building the infrastructure enabling Revolut's continuous growth. Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch. What you'll be doing Managing accurate and compliant employment-related payments and deductions for assigned countries Providing the highest level of service by advising employees on payroll-related questions, ensuring deadlines and SLAs Ensuring accurate and timely data collection and validation Liaising with key stakeholders, such as HR, payroll providers, and Finance Forecasting salaries and bank transfers Overseeing proper statutory and internal reporting Participating in payroll audits Streamlining and documenting internal processes and policies Enhancing and establishing efficient controls to reduce risk of failing Spearheading compensation and benefits initiatives in close collaboration with the HR Advisory team What you'll need 4+ years of experience as a Payroll Administrator, Payroll Specialist, or Payroll Analyst managing end-to-end cycles In-depth knowledge of local income tax, social security, pension, statutory leaves, and other payroll elements Hands-on experience with payroll and HR software Experience managing payroll integrations and complex systems Experience in vendor management and working with external partners Building a global financial super app isn't enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that's why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We're doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That's why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working te am.Important notice for candidat es:Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open rol es.- Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don't use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitme nt.- Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.Com doma in.We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it's a scam. Report it immediate ly.By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notic e.

title: Senior Technical Consultant – Front Arena
description:

Are you someone who understands a technology solution inside and out — and knows how to turn that knowledge into real value for clients? We're looking for someone who doesn't fit the traditional mold of Account Manager or Technical Support. We need both at once: a technical consultant who speaks the client's language, understands their operations, and knows exactly how our platform can grow their business. This role is not primarily focused on acquiring new clients. Your mission will be to deepen, expand, and maximize the value our current clients get from the platform — through upselling, cross-selling, and long-term consultative relationships. ABOUT THE COMPANY A SaaS company in regional expansion, delivering high-impact solutions for enterprise clients across LATAM. The platform supports complex operational processes and integrates with clients' existing systems to generate measurable business value. Agile team, high-performance culture, and a product that keeps evolving. This role is central to that growth. YOUR MISSION You will be the strategic link between the company and its most important clients. Your job is to make sure each client not only uses the platform well, but continuously discovers new ways it can transform their business. From day one, you'll operate as a trusted technical consultant: someone who understands the solution's architecture, knows the integration possibilities, and can articulate expansion opportunities in the client's language. WHAT YOU'LL DO Account Growth – Identify and execute upselling and cross-selling opportunities within the existing client base. – Build account growth plans: understand each client's roadmap and align it with our product evolution. – Manage renewal and expansion cycles with a long-term focus. Applied Technical Consulting – Develop a deep understanding of how our platform works: architecture, modules, APIs, and integrations. – Analyze client systems (ERP, BMS, CMMS, CRM, and others) to identify integration and expansion opportunities. – Participate in technical meetings, discovery sessions, and consultative presentations alongside product and engineering teams. Strategic Client Relationships – Maintain high-level relationships with technical, operational, and executive stakeholders within each account. – Be the client's go-to consultative reference: the person they call when they want to evolve, not just when they have a problem. – Monitor account health (adoption, usage, ROI) and act proactively on risk or opportunity signals. Internal Collaboration – Work closely with Product, Engineering, and Customer Support teams to ensure a cohesive client experience. – Translate client needs into the product roadmap in a structured, evidence-based way. – Maintain pipeline, forecast, and expansion metrics in CRM with rigor and consistency. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR Experience – 4 to 7 years in Customer Success, Technical Account Management, or Technical Consulting roles at SaaS or technology companies. – Proven track record managing enterprise accounts through expansion and renewal cycles. – Demonstrable history of upselling and cross-selling driven by technical knowledge and consultative relationships. – Experience in LATAM markets is highly valued. Technical Profile (core requirement)– Background in Computer Engineering, Information Systems, Telecommunications, or related fields — or a commercial profile with a solid, demonstrable technical foundation. – Genuine ability to understand how software works: modules, integrations, APIs, and data flows. – Experience engaging with client system architectures and evaluating integration scenarios. – Comfortable moving between technical conversations (IT, Engineering) and executive ones (C-Level, Operations). description:

Company Description Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.The RoleThis is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role. You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.In practice, that means:Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contactDriving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six monthsAnalysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting themRunning Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reportingMaintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalateSurfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to actSupporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business caseYou'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.What this role requiresFluent English: written and spoken;
all customer and internal work is conducted in English;
(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously, across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fitExperience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over timeTechnical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translatorWillingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand companyWhat will make you stand outBackground in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similarExperience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalentActive, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis qualityFamiliarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologiesWhat you'll be measured onRelationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.CompensationCompetitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Power Electronics Pcb Design Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Power Electronics Pcb Design Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar. About Turing Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems. Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge;
and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Power Electronics PCB Design Expert to design, evaluate, and validate power electronic circuits and PCB layouts. The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in power supply design, component selection, PCB layout best practices, and design verification methodologies. Key Responsibilties Design power electronic circuits including DC-DC converters, LDOs, AC-DC power supplies, and automotive power systems. Create schematics and PCB layouts using tools such as KiCad, Altium, or equivalent. Select components based on electrical, thermal, and reliability requirements. Perform design analysis for efficiency, ripple, thermal performance, EMI, and manufacturability. Generate manufacturing deliverables including BOMs, Gerber files, and assembly data. Validate designs through simulations, calculations, DRC/LVS checks, and design reviews. Develop and apply verification frameworks for schematic and PCB layout quality, including specification compliance, topology validation, component derating, DFM, thermal integrity, and power integrity. Required Skills Strong understanding of power electronics fundamentals (DC-DC converters, switching regulators, LDOs, power components). Hands-on experience with schematic design and PCB layout. Proficiency with PCB design tools (KiCad, Altium, or similar). Ability to interpret datasheets and validate component selection. Knowledge of DRC, manufacturability, grounding, routing, and EMI best practices. Preferred Skills Experience with AC-DC power supply design and automotive electronics. Familiarity with thermal analysis, power integrity, and simulation tools. Experience developing hardware validation or evaluation frameworks. Basic scripting experience (Python/terminal-based verification workflows). Qualification Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical/Electronics Engineering or related field. 5+ years of experience in power electronics and PCB design. Key Compentencies Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Attention to detail and design quality. Ability to work independently and collaborate across teams. Effective communication skills.

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Full Stack Engineer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Freight Hero FreightHero is an AI-native services company built to support the freight brokerage industry, which is in dire need of it. Robin, our autonomous AI agent, handles back-office work end to end. Our Heroes, a sharp human-in-the-loop team, catch the edge cases. Brokers pay us per load, see ROI in weeks, and reassign or eliminate the teams they used to rent. We are backed by incredible investors, including Andrew Ng's AI Fund and supply chain specialists Dynamo Ventures. The thesis is proven. What is next is growth, and that means building a team of incredible people around us to push the company to the next level. The product is real, the customers are real, the revenue is real, and joining now means shaping how this company runs. About the Role This is a senior full‑stack engineering role focused on building and scaling the core Freight Hero platform. You will work across backend services, integrations, internal tools, and customer-facing features, primarily using Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS. You won’t be inheriting a legacy monolith. You’ll be contributing to a modern, event‑driven, AI‑powered system and helping us scale it as customer adoption accelerates. You’ll collaborate closely with product, AI, and customer teams to translate real operational workflows into robust, reliable software. As the team grows, you’ll have opportunities to mentor others, influence architecture, and shape engineering best practices. What Success Looks Like A successful engineer in this role: Builds scalable, reliable services in Node.Js/TypeScript that integrate deeply with customer systems. Designs and maintains AWS‑native infrastructure that is observable, secure, and cost‑efficient. Works cross‑functionally to understand customer workflows and translate them into technical solutions. Ships high‑quality features quickly while maintaining engineering excellence. Identifies opportunities to automate, optimize, and expand the platform. Contributes to a culture of ownership, clarity, and continuous improvement. Key Responsibilities: Full Stack Engineering Build backend services, APIs, and workflow engines using Node.Js + TypeScript. Contribute to frontend components when needed using React + VueJS. Implement robust testing, observability, and CI/CD practices. AWS native Architecture Design and maintain cloud infrastructure using AWS services such as Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, SQS, SNS, API Gateway, and more. Ensure systems are scalable, secure, and cost‑optimized. Systems Integration Build integrations with TMS platforms, carrier systems, and customer‑specific tools. Work with internal teams to understand operational processes and translate them into scalable technical solutions. AI Forward Development Collaborate with AI engineers to embed LLM‑powered workflows into the product. Use AI tools to accelerate development, improve code quality, and automate repetitive tasks. Identify opportunities to expand AI‑driven automation across the platform. Collaboration & Impact Work closely with product, operations, and customer success to deeply understand customer needs. Participate in technical discussions, architectural decisions, and roadmap planning. Help establish engineering best practices as the team grows. What We Are Looking For 8+ years of professional software engineering experience. Strong expertise in Node.Js, TypeScript, React, and AWS cloud architecture. Experience building distributed systems, event‑driven architectures, or workflow automation. Comfortable working across the stack (backend‑heavy, but able to contribute to frontend). Strong communicator who collaborates well with non‑technical teams. High ownership mindset - you thrive in fast‑moving, ambiguous environments. Curiosity about AI and eagerness to leverage it in your day‑to‑day work. Bonus: experience in freight tech, logistics, or integrations with TMS/ERP systems. Why Freight Hero Built at the intersection of AI and logistics, one of the most impactful spaces in B2B tech. Work with a team that moves fast, thinks big, and cares deeply about customer outcomes. Opportunities to mentor, influence architecture, and grow as the engineering team scales. Competitive compensation with performance incentives. Fully remote with a collaborative, high‑performance culture.

- Familiaridade com ferramentas de ITSM, CRM, dashboards, bases de conhecimento, sistemas de chamados e relatórios de acompanhamento;
- Capacidade de interpretar indicadores, identificar tendências, estruturar planos de ação e acompanhar pendências de forma objetiva. Informações adicionais: BENEFÍCIOS DE SER VISION!
